worker_selection.rationale: Current selected-Host effect-equivalence and acceptance require independent specification judgment.
Native launch, pre-effect decisions, identity and final result consumers changed.
Counterexamples, native raw effects and current release evidence establish qualification.
The code lens covers changed terminal, denial and refusal paths; no separate recovery architecture changed.
The existing CLI worker and shared permission policy are reused; spec/code cover the architectural boundary.
Maintained contracts and host limitations are covered by specification.

findings.title: Native result consumption does not require a matching tool start event
findings.trigger: A stream contains a permission decision and a matching tool_execution_end event but no tool_execution_start event.
findings.impact: The parser can accept a completed native tool effect without evidence that the corresponding execution boundary was started, weakening protocol completeness and the pre-effect evidence chain.
findings.evidence: The completeness check only iterates over starts and verifies that each start has a later matching completion; it never verifies that every completion has a preceding matching start. The focused tests cover a completion without a decision, but not a completion without a start.
findings.suggestion: Require one-to-one matching start/end pairs by tool call ID and name, with each completion occurring after its start, and add a regression test for an end-only stream.

positive_observations: Three separate native Pi sessions independently reviewed specification, code and tests; Codex authored implementation and coordinated synthesis.
The final full release completed after reviewers read its earlier excerpt: 804 Node checks, 104 Hook checks and audit zero, observed process exit 0. Original excerpt limitations remain unchanged.
The exact local native path delivered legitimate work and denied five attempted effects through production consumers; a no-bootstrap public launch also finished with a stopped writer.
limitations: review-tests-001 is retained P2. Actual qualification calls include matched start/end pairs independently checked by the coordinator.
Reviewer-supplied 08:00Z timestamps are not execution freshness; native sessions and operator observations are retained in the trace archive.
No C/D/E, W2-W4, parallel delivery or full eight-step outcome is established.
This qualification is not a general network sandbox, read-location isolation or Pi plugin installation claim.
